project_type: Next.js 14 App Router full-stack application with AI-powered news analysis
language: TypeScript (frontend + API routes), Python not needed since we use Next.js API routes with AI APIs
build_system: npm with Next.js 14, deployed to Vercel
test_framework: Jest with React Testing Library for components, integration tests for API routes
verification_instructions: 1. Run npm run build to verify Next.js builds successfully. 2. Run npm run lint to check code quality. 3. Verify all pages render without errors.
setup_instructions: 1. source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh to get node in PATH. 2. npm install in project root. 3. Copy .env.example to .env.local and add API keys.
environment_constraints: Node.js accessed via nvm (must source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh). OPEN_INTERNET mode - full package install and API access available. Target deployment is Vercel.
contribution_requirements: Create feature branch, commit, push, open PR to main. Never push directly to main.
key_patterns: Next.js 14 App Router conventions: app/ directory for routes, components/ for shared UI, lib/ for utilities, API routes in app/api/. Use server components by default, client components only when needed for interactivity.
directory_structure: Next.js 14 App Router structure: app/ (pages + API routes), components/ (React components), lib/ (utilities, data fetching, AI processing), public/ (static assets), types/ (TypeScript types)
